findings.message: Part removal lacks author confirmation. The build-marker part is removed in the proposed recipe, but the PR author has not confirmed the removal is intentional. Per §3, source bumps that drop parts: entries require either restoration or explicit author confirmation; upstream commit messages do not satisfy this requirement.

summary: Trigger commit bumped to 0000000000000000000000000000000000000007; recipe removes build-marker part. Part confirmed unused with no runtime impact. Author confirmation of intentionality required; revision remains at edge until confirmed.
